title: Vision evidence from a local Qwen VLM makes correction-LLM repair beat numeric-only repair (development-only E10 pilot)
hypothesis: Adding a validated visual failure analysis (Qwen VL on the five rule-selected frames of the parent's worst <=3 failed screen episodes, merged with the numbers by lares.vision.merge) to the Stage F numeric evidence packet lets the correction LLM localise the failing component, so its repairs win more held-out episodes than the identical numeric-only arm at the same repair-episode cap.

prediction.against: arm llm_numeric in the same cell: same structure, same independent data/split/probe bundle and fitting seed, same common preprocessing, acceptance rule, repair-episode cap and held-out cases (pool seed 2629); no_repair reported as a second control
prediction.rationale: Stage F LLM arms were flat and only intervention evidence produced LLM wins, so richer localising evidence is the open lever. 0.05 is a practical target, not a significance cutoff. Uncertainty is a paired t over the 9 independent cells (3 frozen Stage F structures x 3 bundles), with sensitivity to paired held-out-case resampling reported. Tied success is not improvement.

code_changes: lares/repair/correction.py (evidence level numeric_vision, arm llm_numeric_vision, ArmContext.vision_fn; vision reruns counted in the repair-episode cap)
lares/vision/analyst.py (QwenAnalyst: pinned revision, NF4 4-bit language weights with fp16 compute, vision tower unquantized fp16, capped image tokens and output length)
scripts/stage_f.py (per-cell independent bundles from config 'cells'; reserve/build for the vision config; vision arm wiring; VLM memory smoke check)
config/stage_f_vision/stage_f_vision.yaml (new; arms no_repair, llm_numeric, llm_numeric_vision; Stage F's frozen structures from config/stage_f/selection.json + simple_damped_push)
.venv-metaworld on the GPU box: transformers, accelerate, bitsandbytes; Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct@cc594898137f460bfe9f0759e9844b3ce807cfb5

falsified_by: Upper 95% bound of vision-minus-numeric paired success below 0.05 refutes the target magnitude; at or below zero refutes positive added value; an interval including zero is inconclusive about direction. Frame-citation and geometry-consistency audits are made without consulting held-out outcomes; rejected or empty packets stay in the assigned-arm analysis. If most packets carry no valid visual evidence, the localisation mechanism is inconclusive. Vision vs no_repair is reported separately. No expansion after seeing results; an inconclusive pilot needs a separately specified confirmation sized from its paired variance.
